title: Later Nights Kept When a Guest Leaves a Stay Early (Desk Guidance)
content:
# Desk guidance — later nights kept when a guest leaves a stay in progress

**Rule applied at the desk.** When a guest cancels a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category that is already in progress, the later nights are the nights of the stay after the notice nights. How much of the later nights the cancellation keeps depends on the stay: a stay of 28 nights or more, or a stay whose policy's after-check-in refund percentage is 100, keeps none of them; a shorter stay whose policy's after-check-in refund percentage is above 0 and below 100 keeps 100 minus that percentage, in percent, of them; any other stay keeps all of them. The part of the later nights kept counts among the nights the cancellation keeps.

## Decision table

| Stay | After-check-in refund percentage of its policy | Share of the later nights kept |
|---|---|---|
| 28 nights or more, any policy | any | none (0%) |
| under 28 nights, Flexible | 100.00% | none (0%) |
| under 28 nights, Long-Term | 100.00% | none (0%) |
| under 28 nights, Moderate | 50.00% | 50% (100 less 50) |
| under 28 nights, Limited | 0.00% | all (100%) |
| under 28 nights, Firm | 0.00% | all (100%) |
| under 28 nights, Strict | 0.00% | all (100%) |
| under 28 nights, Super Strict 30 Days | 0.00% | all (100%) |
| under 28 nights, Super Strict 60 Days | 0.00% | all (100%) |

## Input — judgement — output (hypothetical stays)

- *10-night Moderate stay, cancelled on its third night, 1 notice night:* later nights 6; shorter stay with a percentage above 0 and below 100; kept share 50%, that is 3 of the 6 later nights.
- *10-night Strict stay, same dates, no notice night:* later nights 7; percentage 0; all 7 are kept.
- *10-night Flexible stay, same dates, 1 notice night:* later nights 6; percentage 100; none is kept.
- *30-night Moderate stay (lengthened by a change after booking):* 28 nights or more; none of the later nights is kept.
